This is Bas Braams from Centrum Wiskunde & Informatica (CWI), the Dutch national centre for mathematics and computer science. My background is computational physics with a slant towards data analysis. I spent most of my career in the USA. Details in my GitHub page [0] and more details in my CWI home page [1].
My interest in Lean is very recent; it comes from following the news on mathematics and AI/LLM. As an initial effort I am focussing on special functions of applied mathematics, and within that broad topic my very first effort is devoted to implementing in Lean the approach of B. C. Carlson that is exposed in his monograph [2] and in his articles and contributions to the NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions [3]. I intend to use the Topics / maths stream here on Zulip to ask for feedback on that effort.

[0] https://github.com/bjbraams
[1] https://www.cwi.nl/en/people/bastiaan-braams/
[2] Carlson, Bille Chandler. "Special functions of applied mathematics." Academic Press, 1977.
[3] See https://dlmf.nist.gov/.

Hello! I was literally writing the tag extension to link the DLMF and mathlib this Saturday. I was waiting to have some time to see what to tag (well, to have Claude write a list and go through it) before PR-ing, but if there is interest, here is the first PR just adding the parser: #42899. If some kind maintainer thinks it looks good, then anyone can go ahead and add tags.
